description: The features of the FICO HELOC data (heloc_dataset_v1.csv). description, monotonicity and categories: the official data dictionary (heloc_data_dictionary-2.xlsx); label: a plain-English name used in explanations.

target.name: RiskPerformance
target.description: Paid as negotiated flag (12-36 Months). String of Good and Bad

special_values.-9: No Bureau Record or No Investigation
special_values.-7: Condition not Met (e.g. No Inquiries, No Delinquencies)

MSinceOldestTradeOpen.label: number of months since the oldest credit account was opened

MSinceMostRecentTradeOpen.description: Months Since Most Recent Trade Open
MSinceMostRecentTradeOpen.label: number of months since the most recent credit account was opened

AverageMInFile.label: average age of the credit accounts in months

NumSatisfactoryTrades.label: number of credit accounts in good standing

NumTrades60Ever2DerogPubRec.label: number of credit accounts that were ever 60 or more days overdue

NumTrades90Ever2DerogPubRec.label: number of credit accounts that were ever 90 or more days overdue

PercentTradesNeverDelq.label: percentage of credit accounts that were never overdue

MSinceMostRecentDelq.label: number of months since the most recent overdue payment

MaxDelq2PublicRecLast12M.description: Max Delq/Public Records Last 12 Months. See tab "MaxDelq" for each category
MaxDelq2PublicRecLast12M.label: worst payment delay in the last 12 months

MaxDelqEver.description: Max Delinquency Ever. See tab "MaxDelq" for each category
MaxDelqEver.label: worst payment delay ever

NumTotalTrades.description: Number of Total Trades (total number of credit accounts)
NumTotalTrades.label: total number of credit accounts

NumTradesOpeninLast12M.description: Number of Trades Open in Last 12 Months
NumTradesOpeninLast12M.label: number of credit accounts opened in the last 12 months

PercentInstallTrades.label: percentage of credit accounts that are instalment loans

MSinceMostRecentInqexcl7days.description: Months Since Most Recent Inq excl 7days
MSinceMostRecentInqexcl7days.label: number of months since the most recent credit check (excluding the last 7 days)

NumInqLast6M.label: number of credit checks in the last 6 months

NumInqLast6Mexcl7days.description: Number of Inq Last 6 Months excl 7days. Excluding the last 7 days removes inquiries that are likely due to price comparision shopping.
NumInqLast6Mexcl7days.label: number of credit checks in the last 6 months (excluding the last 7 days)

NetFractionRevolvingBurden.description: Net Fraction Revolving Burden. This is revolving balance divided by credit limit
NetFractionRevolvingBurden.label: revolving balance as a percentage of the revolving credit limit

NetFractionInstallBurden.description: Net Fraction Installment Burden. This is installment balance divided by original loan amount
NetFractionInstallBurden.label: outstanding instalment balance as a percentage of the original loan amounts

NumRevolvingTradesWBalance.label: number of revolving accounts (credit cards, credit lines) with a balance

NumInstallTradesWBalance.label: number of instalment loans with a balance

NumBank2NatlTradesWHighUtilization.description: Number Bank/Natl Trades w high utilization ratio
NumBank2NatlTradesWHighUtilization.label: number of bank or national credit-card accounts with high utilisation

PercentTradesWBalance.label: percentage of credit accounts with a balance
